For this question, We have to check the given equation as-

28 & 7 @ 8 % 6 $ 4

 Means

New equation after replacing symbols-

28 ÷ 7 × 8 – 6 + 4

According to the BODMAS rule-

⇒ 4 × 8 - 6 + 4

⇒ 32 - 2

⇒ 30

Hence, Option (1) is correct.
